g.text: No clear time gain across six input settings

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6874

g.text: Every cell compares candidate vs. D0 under identical inputs. Positive = candidate faster on joint-success dates; negative = slower.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16324f

g.text: No cell is a universal win: jointly completed dates differ across cells; unsuccessful attempts are not assigned zero time.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6874

g.text: Intervals: 95% seven-date block bootstrap. The illustrative graph is not a measured 2018 park map. These checks do not validate real-world travel times.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6874

g.text: Source: TouringPlans.com. Exploratory posted-wait simulation, not measured visitor savings. Synthetic travel geometry and service assumptions.
